answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 44148 Country: India Title: Sunnat of entering in Masjid Question: Please let me know proper sunnah way of entering and coming out of the mosque? Answer ID: 44148 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 639/371/L=1434) While entering in the mosque one should put right foot first and recite the following dua: اللهم افتح لى أبواب رحمتك. One should do the intention of Eitikaf also. And while coming out of the mosque one should step out the left foot first and recite the following dua: اللهم إنى أسألك من فضلك. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
